~ Maps a COIN digit 0-15 to its hexadecimal SCROLL character
SCROLL hex_digit(COIN d) [
    SCROLL r = "0"!!
    CHART (d) [
        COURSE 0:  r = "0"!! LAND!!
        COURSE 1:  r = "1"!! LAND!!
        COURSE 2:  r = "2"!! LAND!!
        COURSE 3:  r = "3"!! LAND!!
        COURSE 4:  r = "4"!! LAND!!
        COURSE 5:  r = "5"!! LAND!!
        COURSE 6:  r = "6"!! LAND!!
        COURSE 7:  r = "7"!! LAND!!
        COURSE 8:  r = "8"!! LAND!!
        COURSE 9:  r = "9"!! LAND!!
        COURSE 10: r = "A"!! LAND!!
        COURSE 11: r = "B"!! LAND!!
        COURSE 12: r = "C"!! LAND!!
        COURSE 13: r = "D"!! LAND!!
        COURSE 14: r = "E"!! LAND!!
        COURSE 15: r = "F"!! LAND!!
        ADRIFT:    r = "?"!! LAND!!
    ]
    BACK r!!
]
~ Returns AYE if every digit of b is 0 or 1, NAY otherwise
BOOL is_valid_bin(COIN b) [
    COIN d     = 0!!
    BOOL valid = AYE!!
    HEAVE (b > 0) [
        d = b % 10!!
        LOOK ((d != 0) && (d != 1)) [
            valid = NAY!!
        ]
        b = (b - d) / 10!!
    ]
    BACK valid!!
]
~ Converts a binary number typed as a COIN (e.g. 1010) to its decimal value
COIN bin_to_dec(COIN b) [
    COIN dec = 0!!
    COIN pos = 1!!
    COIN d   = 0!!
    HEAVE (b > 0) [
        d    = b % 10!!
        dec += d * pos!!
        pos *= 2!!
        b    = (b - d) / 10!!
    ]
    BACK dec!!
]
~ Prints the binary representation of decimal n
ABYSS print_bin(COIN n) [
    SCROLL result = "0"!!
    COIN rem = 0!!
    LOOK (n == 0) [
        ECHO("0")!!
    ] DROP [
        rem    = n % 2!!
        n      = (n - rem) / 2!!
        result = hex_digit(rem)!!
        HEAVE (n > 0) [
            rem    = n % 2!!
            n      = (n - rem) / 2!!
            result = hex_digit(rem) & result!!
        ]
        ECHO("%S", result)!!
    ]
]
~ Prints the octal representation of decimal n
ABYSS print_oct(COIN n) [
    SCROLL result = "0"!!
    COIN rem = 0!!
    LOOK (n == 0) [
        ECHO("0")!!
    ] DROP [
        rem    = n % 8!!
        n      = (n - rem) / 8!!
        result = hex_digit(rem)!!
        HEAVE (n > 0) [
            rem    = n % 8!!
            n      = (n - rem) / 8!!
            result = hex_digit(rem) & result!!
        ]
        ECHO("%S", result)!!
    ]
]
~ Prints the hexadecimal representation of decimal n
ABYSS print_hex(COIN n) [
    SCROLL result = "0"!!
    COIN rem = 0!!
    LOOK (n == 0) [
        ECHO("0")!!
    ] DROP [
        rem    = n % 16!!
        n      = (n - rem) / 16!!
        result = hex_digit(rem)!!
        HEAVE (n > 0) [
            rem    = n % 16!!
            n      = (n - rem) / 16!!
            result = hex_digit(rem) & result!!
        ]
        ECHO("%S", result)!!
    ]
]

BOOL check_digit(SCROLL c) [
    BACK c == "0" || c == "1" || c == "2" || c == "3" || c == "4" ||
         c == "5" || c == "6" || c == "7" || c == "8" || c == "9"!!
]

BOOL check_special(SCROLL c) [
    BACK c == "!" || c == "@" || c == "#" || c == "$" || c == "%" ||
         c == "^" || c == "&" || c == "*" || c == "(" || c == ")" ||

COIN str_length(SCROLL s) [
    SCROLL word!!
    COIN len!!
    word = s!!
    len = 0!!
    HEAVE (len < 25) [
        LOOK (word{len} == "\0") [
            LAND!!
        ]
        len += 1!!
    ]
    BACK len!!
]

BOOL validate_user(SCROLL uname) [
    SCROLL name!!
    COIN length!!
    BOOL has_upper!!
    BOOL has_digit!!
    BOOL has_special!!
    BOOL result!!
    name = uname!!
    length = str_length(name)!!
    has_upper = NAY!!
    has_digit = NAY!!
    has_special = NAY!!
    ~ Iterate through each character and check for required types
    HOIST (COIN i = 0!! i < length!! +#i) [
        LOOK (check_upper(name{i})) [
            has_upper = AYE!!
        ]
        LOOK (check_digit(name{i})) [
            has_digit = AYE!!
        ]
        LOOK (check_special(name{i})) [
            has_special = AYE!!
        ]
    ]
    ~ Username is valid only if ALL conditions are satisfied
    result = length >= 8 && has_upper && has_digit && has_special!!
    BACK result!!
]

    ]

~ Reverses a COIN number and returns it
COIN reverse_num(COIN n) [
    COIN rev = 0!!
    COIN rem = 0!!
    HEAVE (n > 0) [
        rem = n % 10!!
        rev = rev * 10 + rem!!
        n   = (n - rem) / 10!!
    ]
    BACK rev!!
]

AHOY() [
    PARCH word{50}!!

    COIN num    = 1!!
    COIN orig   = 0!!
    COIN rev    = 0!!
    COIN len    = 0!!
    COIN left   = 0!!
    COIN right  = 0!!
    BOOL pal    = AYE!!
    ECHO("=================================\n")!!
    ECHO("        Palindrome Checker       \n")!!

    CHART (choice) [
        COURSE 1:
            HAUL [
                ECHO("\nEnter a positive number: ")!!

                LOOK (num <= 0) [
                    ECHO("\nInvalid! Please enter a positive number (greater than 0).\n")!!
                ]
            ] HEAVE (num == 0)!!
            orig = num!!
            rev  = reverse_num(num)!!
            ECHO("\n--- Result ---\n")!!
            LOOK (orig == rev) [
                ECHO("%C is a palindrome.\n", orig)!!
            ] DROP [
                ECHO("%C is not a palindrome.\n", orig)!!

        COURSE 2:

            len = 0!!

            ]
            LOOK (len == 0) [
                ECHO("\nInvalid! No characters were entered.\n")!!
            ] DROP [
                left  = 0!!
                right = len - 1!!
                pal   = AYE!!
                HEAVE (left < right) [

                        pal = NAY!!
                    ]

                ]

    ECHO("=================================\n")!!
]

    HAUL [

    input_a(rows_a, cols_a)!!

    ~ ask input from the user - Matrix B
    ECHO("\n===== ENTER MATRIX B =====\n")!!
    HAUL [
        ASK("Rows: %C", @rows_b)!!
        LOOK (rows_b <= 0) [
            ECHO("Invalid! Rows must be greater than 0.\n")!!
        ]
    ] HEAVE (rows_b <= 0)!!
    HAUL [
        ASK("Cols: %C", @cols_b)!!
        LOOK (cols_b <= 0) [
            ECHO("Invalid! Cols must be greater than 0.\n")!!
        ]
    ] HEAVE (cols_b <= 0)!!
    ECHO("\nEnter elements of Matrix B:\n")!!
    input_b(rows_b, cols_b)!!

    ECHO("\n--- Matrix A ---\n")!!
    print_a(rows_a, cols_a)!!
    ECHO("\n--- Matrix B ---\n")!!
    print_b(rows_b, cols_b)!!

    ~ main menu
    HAUL [
        ECHO("\n====== MATRIX MENU ======\n")!!
        ECHO("[1] Matrix Addition\n")!!
        ECHO("[2] Matrix Multiplication\n")!!
        ECHO("[3] Matrix Transpose\n")!!
        ECHO("[4] EXIT\n")!!
        ECHO("=========================\n")!!
        ASK("Choice: %C", @choice)!!
        LOOK (choice == 4) [
            ECHO("\nGoodbye!\n")!!
            LAND!!
        ]
        CHART(choice) [
            COURSE 1:
                LOOK (rows_a == rows_b && cols_a == cols_b) [
                    add_matrices(rows_a, cols_a)!!
                    ECHO("\n--- Result (A + B) ---\n")!!
                    print_c(rows_a, cols_a)!!
                ] DROP [
                    ECHO("\nCannot add! Both matrices must have equal dimensions.\n")!!
                ]
                LAND!!
            COURSE 2:
                LOOK (cols_a == rows_b) [
                    multiply_matrices(rows_a, cols_a, cols_b)!!
                    ECHO("\n--- Result (A x B) ---\n")!!
                    print_c(rows_a, cols_b)!!
                ] DROP [
                    ECHO("\nCannot multiply! Cols of A must equal Rows of B.\n")!!
                ]
                LAND!!
            COURSE 3:
                transpose_matrix(rows_a, cols_a)!!
                ECHO("\n--- Transpose of A ---\n")!!
                print_c(cols_a, rows_a)!!
                LAND!!
            ADRIFT:
                ECHO("\nInvalid choice! Try again.\n")!!
                LAND!!
        ]
    ] HEAVE (choice != 4)!!
]

column2:
Student Records
Create a program that:
- Adds student records (name, student number, course)
- Displays all records
- Searches by student number
- Menu
 Add Record
 Display Record (all)
 Search Record (individual)
 Edit Record
 Delete Record
 Exit
column3:
~( Program 2: Student Records Management System 
   Add, Edit, Delete, Display, and Search student records )~

~ Declare array for Student Name, Number, and Course
~ Maximum of 50 records
SCROLL names{50}!!
COIN nums{50}!!
SCROLL courses{50}!!
COIN count = 0!!

~ Checks if Student Record exists
COIN find(COIN target)[
  COIN id = -1!!
  HOIST(COIN i = 0!! i <= count!! +#i)[
    LOOK(nums{i} == target)[
      id = i!!
    ] DROP [
      SAIL!!
    ]
  ]
  BACK id!!
]             

~ ADD a Student Record
ABYSS add_sr() [
  COIN num!!
  SCROLL name, course!!
  BOOL invalid = NAY!!
  
  LOOK (count >= 50) [
    ECHO("[INVALID] Maximum of 50 records reached.\n")!!
  ] DROP [
    ECHO("\n--- Add Student Record ---\n")!!
    
    ECHO("Student Name   : ")!!
    ASK("%S", @name)!!
    
    ECHO("Student Number : ")!!
    ASK("%C", @num)!!
    
    HAUL[
      LOOK(num < 0) [
        invalid = AYE!!
        ECHO("[INVALID] Student number must be numbers only.")!!
        ECHO("\nEnter a new student number: ")!!
        ASK("%C", @num)!!
      ] DROPLOOK(find(num) != -1)[
        invalid = AYE!!
        ECHO("[INVALID] Student number %C already exists.", num)!!
        ECHO("\nEnter a new student number: ")!!
        ASK("%C", @num)!!
      ] DROP [
        invalid = NAY!!
      ]
    ] HEAVE(invalid == AYE)!!
        
    ECHO("Course         : ")!!
    ASK("%S", @course)!!

    names{count} = name!!
    nums{count} = num!!
    courses{count} = course!!
    count += 1!!

    ECHO("--- Record added successfully. ---\n")!!
  ] 
]

~ DISPLAY all Student Records
ABYSS display_sr() [
  ECHO("\n--- Student Record(s) ---\n")!!
    HOIST (COIN i = 0!! i < count!! +#i) [
      ECHO("\n[ Record %C ]\n", i+1)!!
      ECHO("Name           : %S\n", names{i})!!
      ECHO("Student Number : %C\n", nums{i})!!
      ECHO("Course         : %S\n", courses{i})!!
    ]
  ECHO("\n--- Total of %C Student Record/s", count)!!
]

~ SEARCH for a Student Record/s
ABYSS search_sr() [
  COIN amt, target, id, a=0!!
  
  ECHO("\n--- Search Student Record ---\n")!!
  HAUL[
    ECHO("Enter how many students to search: ")!!
    ASK("%C", @amt)!!
    
    LOOK(amt <= count) [
      HAUL[
        ECHO("\nEnter student number to search: ")!!
        ASK("%C", @target)!!
        id = find(target)!!

        LOOK (id != -1) [
          ECHO("\nRecord Found:\n")!!
          ECHO("Name           : %S\n", names{id})!!
          ECHO("Student Number : %C\n", nums{id})!!
          ECHO("Course         : %S\n", courses{id})!!
              +#a!!
        ] DROP [
          ECHO("\n[INVALID] Student number %C does not exist.\n", target)!!
        ] 
      ] HEAVE(a != amt)!!
    ] DROP [
      ECHO("\n[INVALID] The number exceeds the total existing records.\n")!!
    ]
  ] HEAVE(amt >= count)!!
]

~ EDIT a Student Record
ABYSS edit_sr() [
  COIN target, edit, id!!
  
  ECHO("\n--- Edit Student Record ---\n")!!
  ECHO("Enter student number to edit: ")!!
  ASK("%C", @target)!!
  id = find(target)!!
  
  LOOK (id != -1) [
    ECHO("\nCurrent Record:\n")!!
    ECHO("Name           : %S\n", names{id})!!
    ECHO("Student Number : %C\n", nums{id})!!
    ECHO("Course         : %S\n", courses{id})!!

    HAUL[
      ECHO("\nEnter detail/s to edit:\n")!!
      ECHO("[1] Name\n[2] Course\n[3] Name & Course\n")!!
      ASK("%C", @edit)!!

      CHART(edit)[
        COURSE 1:
          ECHO("Enter new name: ")!!
          ASK("%S", @names{id})!!
          LAND!!
        COURSE 2:
          ECHO("Enter new course: ")!!
          ASK("%S", @courses{id})!!
          LAND!!
        COURSE 3:
          ECHO("Enter new name: ")!!
          ASK("%S", @names{id})!!
          ECHO("\nEnter new course: ")!!
          ASK("%S", @courses{id})!!
          LAND!!
        ADRIFT:
          ECHO("Invalid choice.\n")!!
          LAND!!
        ]
      ] HEAVE (edit > 3 && edit < 1)!!

      ECHO("Record updated successfully.\n")!!
    ] DROP [
      ECHO("[INVALID] Student number %C not found.\n", target)!!
    ]
]

~ DELETE a Student Record
ABYSS delete_sr() [
  COIN target, id, i, upd!!
  
  ECHO("\n--- Delete Student Record ---\n")!!
  ECHO("Enter student number to delete: ")!!
  ASK("%C", @target)!!
  id = find(target)!!

  LOOK (id != -1) [
    ECHO("\nDeleting record:\n")!!
    ECHO("Name           : %S\n", names{id})!!
    ECHO("Student Number : %C\n", nums{id})!!
    ECHO("Course         : %S\n", courses{id})!!

    HOIST (i = id!! i < count - 1!! +#i) [
      upd = i + 1!!
      names{i} = names{upd}!!
      nums{i} = nums{upd}!!
      courses{i} = courses{upd}!!
    ]
    count -= 1!!
    ECHO("Record deleted successfully.\n")!!
  ] DROP [
    ECHO("[INVALID] Student number %C not found.\n", target)!!
  ]
]

AHOY() [
    COIN choice, exit!!
    BOOL continue = AYE!!
    
    HAUL [
        ECHO("\n========================================\n")!!
        ECHO("     STUDENT RECORD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM\n")!!
        ECHO("========================================\n")!!
        ECHO("[1] Add Record\n")!!
        ECHO("[2] Display Records\n")!!
        ECHO("[3] Search Record\n")!!
        ECHO("[4] Edit Record\n")!!
        ECHO("[5] Delete Record\n")!!
        ECHO("[6] Exit\n")!!
        ECHO("----------------------------------------\n")!!
        
        ECHO("Enter choice: ")!!
        ASK("%C", @choice)!!

        CHART (choice) [
        COURSE 1:
          add_sr()!!
          LAND!!
        COURSE 2:
          LOOK(count < 1) [
            ECHO("\nThere are no existing records yet.\n")!!
          ] DROP [
            display_sr()!!
          ] LAND!!
        COURSE 3:
          LOOK(count < 1) [
            ECHO("\nThere are no existing records yet.\n")!!
          ] DROP [
            search_sr()!!
          ] LAND!!
        COURSE 4:
          LOOK(count < 1) [
            ECHO("\nThere are no existing records yet.\n")!!
          ] DROP [
            edit_sr()!!
          ] LAND!!
        COURSE 5:
          LOOK(count < 1) [
            ECHO("\nThere are no existing records yet.\n")!!
          ] DROP [
            delete_sr()!!
          ] LAND!!
        COURSE 6:
          ECHO("Exiting System...")!!
          continue = NAY!!
          LAND!!
        ADRIFT:
          ECHO("Invalid choice.\n")!!
          LAND!!
        ]
    ] HEAVE (continue != NAY)!!
]

column2:
Banking Transactions
Simulate: 
- Deposit 
- Withdraw
- Balance inquiry
- Display trxn’s summary

 Data included: Client name, client account number, date
 Input: number of clients, number of trxns per client
 Max number of clients: 5 , each clients can have at least 5 trxns per day.  Maximum deposit: 50,000php
 Maximum Withdrawal: 20,000php
 Amount to be withdrawn <= balance
column3:
AHOY() [
    COIN num_clients = 0, num_trxns = 0, choice = 0, add_more = 0!!
    COIN i = 0, k = 0, m = 0, type = 0, global_idx = 0!!
    COIN global_client_idx = 0, daily_client_cnt = 0, clients_avail = 0!!
    COIN client_num = 0, day_idx = 0, current_client_idx = 0, valid_trxns = 0!!
    DIME amount = 0.0, daily_dep = 0.0, daily_with = 0.0!!
    DIME total_dep_today = 0.0, total_with_today = 0.0!!
    BOOL another_day = AYE, is_unique = AYE, valid_date = NAY!!
    BOOL valid_choice = NAY, more_clients_today = AYE, valid_amount = NAY!!
    SCROLL current_date!!

    SCROLL client_names{100}!!
    COIN client_acc_nums{100}!!
    DIME client_balances{100}!!

    SCROLL prev_dates{25}!!

    COIN trxn_client_idx{100}!!
    COIN trxn_types{100}!!
    DIME trxn_amounts{100}!!
    SCROLL trxn_dates{100}!!

    ECHO("=================================================\n")!!
    ECHO("            SEASTACK BANKING SYSTEM              \n")!!
    ECHO("=================================================\n")!!

    HAUL [
        ECHO("\n=================================================\n")!!
        HAUL [
            valid_date = AYE!!
            ECHO("Enter Transaction Date (e.g. 04-20-2026): ")!!
            ASK("%S", @current_date)!!

            LOOK (current_date{2} != "-" || current_date{5} != "-") [
                ECHO("Error: Invalid date format. Please strictly use mm-dd-yyyy.\n")!!
                valid_date = NAY!!
            ] DROP [
                HOIST (k = 0!! k < day_idx!! +#k) [
                    LOOK (current_date == prev_dates{k}) [
                        ECHO("Error: This date has already been processed. Please enter a new date.\n")!!
                        valid_date = NAY!!
                    ]
                ]
            ]
        ] HEAVE (valid_date == NAY)!!

        prev_dates{day_idx} = current_date!!
        +#day_idx!!

        daily_client_cnt = 0!!
        more_clients_today = AYE!!

        HAUL [
            clients_avail = 5 - daily_client_cnt!!
            ECHO("\n--- Clients available for %S: %C ---\n", current_date, clients_avail)!!
            ECHO("Enter number of clients to process right now: ")!!
            ASK("%C", @num_clients)!!

            LOOK (num_clients > clients_avail) [
                ECHO("Error: You can only process up to %C more clients today.\n", clients_avail)!!
            ] DROPLOOK (num_clients < 0) [
                ECHO("Error: Negative values are not accepted. Try again.\n")!!
            ] DROPLOOK (num_clients == 0) [
                ECHO("Error: Please enter a valid number of clients.\n")!!
            ] DROP [
                
                HOIST (i = 0!! i < num_clients!! +#i) [
                    current_client_idx = global_client_idx!!
                    client_num = current_client_idx + 1!!
                    
                    ECHO("\n--- Client %C Registration ---\n", client_num)!!
                    
                    HAUL [
                        is_unique = AYE!!
                        ECHO("Enter Client Name: ")!!
                        ASK("%S", @client_names{current_client_idx})!!
                        HOIST (m = 0!! m < current_client_idx!! +#m) [
                            LOOK (client_names{current_client_idx} == client_names{m}) [
                                ECHO("Error: Client name already exists. Please choose a different name.\n")!!
                                is_unique = NAY!!
                            ]
                        ]
                    ] HEAVE (is_unique == NAY)!!

                    HAUL [
                        is_unique = AYE!!
                        ECHO("Enter Account Number: ")!!
                        ASK("%C", @client_acc_nums{current_client_idx})!!
                        HOIST (m = 0!! m < current_client_idx!! +#m) [
                            LOOK (client_acc_nums{current_client_idx} == client_acc_nums{m}) [
                                ECHO("Error: Account number already exists. Please enter a different number.\n")!!
                                is_unique = NAY!!
                            ]
                        ]
                    ] HEAVE (is_unique == NAY)!!

                    client_balances{current_client_idx} = 0.0!!

                    ECHO("\n--- Transactions for %S on %S ---\n", client_names{current_client_idx}, current_date)!!
                    
                    HAUL [
                        ECHO("Enter number of transactions for this client (Max 5): ")!!
                        ASK("%C", @num_trxns)!!
                        LOOK (num_trxns > 5) [
                            ECHO("Error: Clients are strictly limited to 5 transactions per day.\n")!!
                        ] DROPLOOK (num_trxns < 0) [
                            ECHO("Error: Negative values are not accepted. Try again.\n")!!
                        ]
                    ] HEAVE (num_trxns > 5 || num_trxns < 0)!!

                    daily_dep = 0.0!!
                    daily_with = 0.0!!
                    
                    valid_trxns = 0!!

                    HEAVE (valid_trxns < num_trxns) [
                        LOOK (global_idx >= 100) [
                            ECHO("Error: System transaction limit reached.\n")!!
                            valid_trxns = num_trxns!!
                        ] DROP [
                            ECHO("\nTransaction Type \n1 - Deposit \n2 - Withdraw \n3 - Inquiry \nChoose an option: ")!!
                            ASK("%C", @type)!!

                            CHART (type) [
                                COURSE 1:
                                    HAUL [
                                        valid_amount = AYE!!
                                        ECHO("Enter Deposit Amount: ")!!
                                        ASK("%D", @amount)!!
                                        total_dep_today = daily_dep + amount!!

                                        LOOK (amount < 0.0) [
                                            ECHO("Error: Negative values are not accepted. Try again.\n")!!
                                            valid_amount = NAY!!
                                        ] DROPLOOK (total_dep_today > 50000.0) [
                                            ECHO("Error: Combined deposits for this date exceed 50000.0 php. Try again.\n")!!
                                            valid_amount = NAY!!
                                        ]
                                    ] HEAVE (valid_amount == NAY)!!

                                    client_balances{current_client_idx} += amount!!
                                    daily_dep += amount!!
                                    
                                    trxn_client_idx{global_idx} = current_client_idx!!
                                    trxn_dates{global_idx} = current_date!!
                                    trxn_types{global_idx} = type!!
                                    trxn_amounts{global_idx} = amount!!
                                    +#global_idx!!
                                    +#valid_trxns!!
                                    
                                    ECHO("Deposit successful.\n")!!
                                    LAND!!

                                COURSE 2:
                                    HAUL [
                                        valid_amount = AYE!!
                                        ECHO("Enter Withdrawal Amount: ")!!
                                        ASK("%D", @amount)!!
                                        total_with_today = daily_with + amount!!

                                        LOOK (amount < 0.0) [
                                            ECHO("Error: Negative values are not accepted. Try again.\n")!!
                                            valid_amount = NAY!!
                                        ] DROPLOOK (total_with_today > 20000.0) [
                                            ECHO("Error: Combined withdrawals for this date exceed 20000.0 php. Try again.\n")!!
                                            valid_amount = NAY!!
                                        ] DROPLOOK (amount > client_balances{current_client_idx}) [
                                            ECHO("Error: Insufficient balance. Try again.\n")!!
                                            valid_amount = NAY!!
                                        ]
                                    ] HEAVE (valid_amount == NAY)!!

                                    client_balances{current_client_idx} -= amount!!
                                    daily_with += amount!!
                                    
                                    trxn_client_idx{global_idx} = current_client_idx!!
                                    trxn_dates{global_idx} = current_date!!
                                    trxn_types{global_idx} = type!!
                                    trxn_amounts{global_idx} = amount!!
                                    +#global_idx!!
                                    +#valid_trxns!!
                                    
                                    ECHO("Withdrawal successful.\n")!!
                                    LAND!!

                                COURSE 3:
                                    ECHO("Current Balance Inquiry: %D php\n", client_balances{current_client_idx})!!
                                    
                                    trxn_client_idx{global_idx} = current_client_idx!!
                                    trxn_dates{global_idx} = current_date!!
                                    trxn_types{global_idx} = type!!
                                    trxn_amounts{global_idx} = 0.0!!
                                    +#global_idx!!
                                    +#valid_trxns!!
                                    LAND!!

                                ADRIFT:
                                    ECHO("Invalid Transaction Type. Try again.\n")!!
                                    LAND!!
                            ]
                        ]
                    ]
                    +#global_client_idx!!
                ]
                
                daily_client_cnt += num_clients!!

                LOOK (daily_client_cnt < 5) [
                    HAUL [
                        valid_choice = AYE!!
                        clients_avail = 5 - daily_client_cnt!!
                        ECHO("\nYou can still add %C client(s) for %S.\n", clients_avail, current_date)!!
                        ECHO("Would you like to add more clients for today? (1 for Yes, 0 for No): ")!!
                        ASK("%C", @add_more)!!

                        LOOK (add_more != 1 && add_more != 0) [
                            ECHO("Error: Invalid choice format. Please enter exactly 1 or 0.\n")!!
                            valid_choice = NAY!!
                        ]
                    ] HEAVE (valid_choice == NAY)!!

                    LOOK (add_more == 0) [
                        more_clients_today = NAY!!
                    ]
                ] DROPLOOK (daily_client_cnt >= 5) [
                    ECHO("\nMaximum daily limit of 5 clients reached for %S.\n", current_date)!!
                    more_clients_today = NAY!!
                ]
            ]
        ] HEAVE (more_clients_today == AYE)!!

        HAUL [
            valid_choice = AYE!!
            ECHO("\nWould you like to process another day? (1 for Yes, 0 for No): ")!!
            ASK("%C", @choice)!!
            
            LOOK (choice != 1 && choice != 0) [
                ECHO("Error: Invalid choice format. Please enter exactly 1 or 0.\n")!!
                valid_choice = NAY!!
            ]
        ] HEAVE (valid_choice == NAY)!!

        LOOK (choice == 0) [
            another_day = NAY!!
        ]
    ] HEAVE (another_day == AYE)!!

    ECHO("\n================ TRANSACTION SUMMARY ================\n")!!
    HOIST (i = 0!! i < global_client_idx!! +#i) [
        ECHO("Client Name: %S\n", client_names{i})!!
        ECHO("Account Number: %C\n", client_acc_nums{i})!!
        ECHO("Final Balance: %D php\n", client_balances{i})!!
        ECHO("--- Transactions ---\n")!!

        HOIST (k = 0!! k < global_idx!! +#k) [
            LOOK (trxn_client_idx{k} == i) [
                type = trxn_types{k}!!
                amount = trxn_amounts{k}!!

                LOOK (type == 1) [
                    ECHO("Date: %S | Type: Deposit  | Amount: %D php\n", trxn_dates{k}, amount)!!
                ] DROPLOOK (type == 2) [
                    ECHO("Date: %S | Type: Withdraw | Amount: %D php\n", trxn_dates{k}, amount)!!
                ]
            ]
        ]
        ECHO("---------------------------------------------------\n")!!
    ]
]

column2:
Jeepney Passengers (Stop) 
 Loading
 Unloading
 Show Passengers
 Exit
Maximum jeep capacity: 22 (excluding the diver)

Constraints:
 Number of passengers <= maximum jeep capacity
 Number of passengers to load <= remaining vacant seat/s
 Number of passengers to unload <= total number of current passengers
 No passenger can seat on the same location
 Jeep driver cannot stop anywhere
 Loading : Loading Area
 Unloading: Unloading Area
column3:
AHOY() [
    COIN choice = 0, i = 0!!
    COIN load_count = 0, unload_count = 0!!
    COIN current_passengers = 0, vacant_seats = 0!!
    COIN loaded = 0, unloaded = 0!!
    COIN display_seat = 0!!

    ~ 0 = Vacant, 1 = Occupied
    COIN seats{22} = [0] !!

    HEAVE (choice != 4) [
        current_passengers = 0!!
        HOIST (i = 0!! i < 22!! +#i) [
            LOOK (seats{i} == 1) [
                +#current_passengers!!
            ]
        ]
        vacant_seats = 22 - current_passengers!!

        ECHO("\n=================================\n")!!
        ECHO("     JEEPNEY PASSENGER SYSTEM    \n")!!
        ECHO("=================================\n")!!
        ECHO("Current Load: %C / 22\n", current_passengers)!!
        ECHO("Vacant Seats: %C\n", vacant_seats)!!
        ECHO("1. Stop at Loading Area\n")!!
        ECHO("2. Stop at Unloading Area\n")!!
        ECHO("3. Show Passenger Seat Locations\n")!!
        ECHO("4. Exit to Terminal\n")!!
        ECHO("Enter choice: ")!!
        ASK("%C", @choice)!!

        CHART (choice) [
            
            COURSE 1:
                ECHO("\n--- LOADING AREA ---\n")!!
                LOOK (vacant_seats == 0) [
                    ECHO("The jeepney is full! Cannot load more passengers.\n")!!
                ] DROP [
                    ECHO("Enter number of passengers to load: ")!!
                    ASK("%C", @load_count)!!

                    ~ Constraint: Number of passengers to load <= remaining vacant seats
                    LOOK (load_count > vacant_seats) [
                        ECHO("Cannot load. Exceeds remaining vacant seats (%C)!\n", vacant_seats)!!
                    ] DROP [
                        loaded = 0!!
                        
                        ~ Find vacant seats (seats{i} == 0)
                        HOIST (i = 0!! i < 22!! +#i) [
                            LOOK (loaded < load_count && seats{i} == 0) [
                                seats{i} = 1!!
                                +#loaded!!
                            ]
                        ]
                        ECHO("Successfully loaded %C passengers.\n", loaded)!!
                    ]
                ]
                LAND!!

            COURSE 2:
                ECHO("\n--- UNLOADING AREA ---\n")!!
                LOOK (current_passengers == 0) [
                    ECHO("The jeepney is empty! No passengers to unload.\n")!!
                ] DROP [
                    ECHO("Enter number of passengers to unload: ")!!
                    ASK("%C", @unload_count)!!

                    ~ Constraint: Number of passengers to unload <= total number of current passengers
                    LOOK (unload_count > current_passengers) [
                        ECHO("Cannot unload. Exceeds current passengers (%C)!\n", current_passengers)!!
                    ] DROP [
                        unloaded = 0!!
                        
                        ~ Unload current passengers (seats{i} == 1) 
                        HOIST (i = 0!! i < 22!! +#i) [
                            LOOK (unloaded < unload_count && seats{i} == 1) [
                                seats{i} = 0!!
                                +#unloaded!!
                            ]
                        ]
                        ECHO("Successfully unloaded %C passengers.\n", unloaded)!!
                    ]
                ]
                LAND!!

            COURSE 3:
                ECHO("\n--- PASSENGER SEAT LOCATIONS ---\n")!!
                HOIST (i = 0!! i < 22!! +#i) [
                    display_seat = i + 1!!
                    
                    LOOK (seats{i} == 1) [
                        ECHO("Seat %C: [OCCUPIED]\n", display_seat)!!
                    ] DROP [
                        ECHO("Seat %C: [Vacant]\n", display_seat)!!
                    ]
                ]

~ PROGRAM 1: MATRIX - Functions
ABYSS input_a(COIN rows, COIN cols) [

]

ABYSS input_b(COIN rows, COIN cols) [
    COIN i, j!!
    HOIST (i = 0!! i < rows!! +#i) [
        HOIST (j = 0!! j < cols!! +#j) [
            ECHO("  [%C][%C]: ", i, j)!!
            ASK("%C", @b{i}{j})!!
        ]
    ]
]

ABYSS print_a(COIN rows, COIN cols) [
    COIN i, j!!
    HOIST (i = 0!! i < rows!! +#i) [
        ECHO("  ")!!
        HOIST (j = 0!! j < cols!! +#j) [

]

ABYSS print_c(COIN rows, COIN cols) [

    HOIST (i = 0!! i < rows!! +#i) [

        HOIST (j = 0!! j < cols!! +#j) [
            ECHO("%C ", c{i}{j})!!
        ]
        ECHO("\n")!!
    ]
]

~ function to add matrix - rows and cols of both A and B must be identical
ABYSS add_matrices(COIN rows, COIN cols) [
    COIN i, j!!
    HOIST (i = 0!! i < rows!! +#i) [
        HOIST (j = 0!! j < cols!! +#j) [
            c{i}{j} = a{i}{j} + b{i}{j}!!
        ]
    ]
]

~ function to multiply matrix - cols of A must equal rows of B
ABYSS multiply_matrices(COIN rows_a, COIN cols_a, COIN cols_b) [
    COIN i, j, k, total!!
    HOIST (i = 0!! i < rows_a!! +#i) [
        HOIST (j = 0!! j < cols_b!! +#j) [
            total = 0!!
            HOIST (k = 0!! k < cols_a!! +#k) [
                total += a{i}{k} * b{k}{j}!!
            ]
            c{i}{j} = total!!
        ]
    ]
]

~ function to transpose matrix
ABYSS transpose_matrix(COIN rows, COIN cols) [
    COIN i, j!!
    HOIST (i = 0!! i < rows!! +#i) [
        HOIST (j = 0!! j < cols!! +#j) [
            c{j}{i} = a{i}{j}!!
        ]
    ]
]

                            LOOK (daily_client_cnt < 5) [
                                HAUL [
                                    valid_choice = AYE!!
                                    clients_avail = 5 - daily_client_cnt!!
                                    ECHO("\nYou can still add %C client(s) for %S.\n", clients_avail, current_date)!!
                                    ECHO("Would you like to add more clients for today? (1 for Yes, 0 for No): ")!!
                                    ASK("%C", @add_more)!!

                                    LOOK (add_more != 1 && add_more != 0) [
                                        ECHO("Error: Invalid choice format. Please enter exactly 1 or 0.\n")!!
                                        valid_choice = NAY!!
                                    ]
                                ] HEAVE (valid_choice == NAY)!!

                                LOOK (add_more == 0) [
                                    more_clients_today = NAY!!
                                ]
                            ] DROPLOOK (daily_client_cnt >= 5) [
                                ECHO("\nMaximum daily limit of 5 clients reached for %S.\n", current_date)!!
                                more_clients_today = NAY!!
                            ]
                        ]
                    ] HEAVE (more_clients_today == AYE)!!

                    ~ Prompt to process another day WITH strict format validation
                    HAUL [
                        valid_choice = AYE!!
                        ECHO("\nWould you like to process another day? (1 for Yes, 0 for No): ")!!
                        ASK("%C", @choice3)!!
                        
                        LOOK (choice3 != 1 && choice3 != 0) [
                            ECHO("Error: Invalid choice format. Please enter exactly 1 or 0.\n")!!
                            valid_choice = NAY!!
                        ]
                    ] HEAVE (valid_choice == NAY)!!

                    LOOK (choice3 == 0) [
                        another_day = NAY!!
                    ]
                ] HEAVE (another_day == AYE)!!

                ~ Display Final Transaction Summary for ALL global clients
                ECHO("\n================ TRANSACTION SUMMARY ================\n")!!
                HOIST (i3 = 0!! i3 < global_client_idx!! +#i3) [
                    ECHO("Client Name: %S\n", client_names{i3})!!
                    ECHO("Account Number: %C\n", client_acc_nums{i3})!!
                    ECHO("Final Balance: %D php\n", client_balances{i3})!!
                    ECHO("--- Transactions ---\n")!!

                    ~ Loop through the global transaction log and extract matches for this client
                    HOIST (k3 = 0!! k3 < global_idx!! +#k3) [
                        LOOK (trxn_client_idx{k3} == i3) [
                            type3 = trxn_types{k3}!!
                            amount = trxn_amounts{k3}!!

                            ~ Only print valid deposits and withdrawals
                            LOOK (type3 == 1) [
                                ECHO("Date: %S | Type: Deposit  | Amount: %D php\n", trxn_dates{k3}, amount)!!
                            ] DROPLOOK (type3 == 2) [
                                ECHO("Date: %S | Type: Withdraw | Amount: %D php\n", trxn_dates{k3}, amount)!!
                            ]
                        ]
                    ]
                    ECHO("---------------------------------------------------\n")!!
                ]
                LAND!!

            ~ ================================================
            ~ PROGRAM 4: JEEPNEY PASSENGERS
            ~ ================================================
            COURSE 4:
                ~ Reset P4 state
                choice4 = 0!!
                i4 = 0!!
                load_count = 0!!
                unload_count = 0!!
                current_passengers = 0!!
                vacant_seats = 0!!
                loaded = 0!!
                unloaded = 0!!
                display_seat = 0!!
                HOIST (i4 = 0!! i4 < 22!! +#i4) [
                    seats{i4} = 0!!
                ]

                ~ 0 = Vacant, 1 = Occupied
                HEAVE (choice4 != 4) [
                    current_passengers = 0!!
                    HOIST (i4 = 0!! i4 < 22!! +#i4) [
                        LOOK (seats{i4} == 1) [
                            +#current_passengers!!
                        ]
                    ]
                    vacant_seats = 22 - current_passengers!!

                    ECHO("\n=================================\n")!!
                    ECHO("     JEEPNEY PASSENGER SYSTEM    \n")!!
                    ECHO("=================================\n")!!
                    ECHO("Current Load: %C / 22\n", current_passengers)!!
                    ECHO("Vacant Seats: %C\n", vacant_seats)!!
                    ECHO("1. Stop at Loading Area\n")!!
                    ECHO("2. Stop at Unloading Area\n")!!
                    ECHO("3. Show Passenger Seat Locations\n")!!
                    ECHO("4. Exit to Terminal\n")!!
                    ECHO("Enter choice: ")!!
                    ASK("%C", @choice4)!!

                    CHART (choice4) [
                        
                        COURSE 1:
                            ECHO("\n--- LOADING AREA ---\n")!!
                            LOOK (vacant_seats == 0) [
                                ECHO("The jeepney is full! Cannot load more passengers.\n")!!
                            ] DROP [
                                ECHO("Enter number of passengers to load: ")!!
                                ASK("%C", @load_count)!!

                                ~ Constraint: Number of passengers to load <= remaining vacant seats
                                LOOK (load_count > vacant_seats) [
                                    ECHO("Cannot load. Exceeds remaining vacant seats (%C)!\n", vacant_seats)!!
                                ] DROP [
                                    loaded = 0!!
                                    
                                    ~ Find vacant seats (seats{i4} == 0)
                                    HOIST (i4 = 0!! i4 < 22!! +#i4) [
                                        LOOK (loaded < load_count && seats{i4} == 0) [
                                            seats{i4} = 1!!
                                            +#loaded!!
                                        ]
                                    ]
                                    ECHO("Successfully loaded %C passengers.\n", loaded)!!
                                ]
                            ]
                            LAND!!

                        COURSE 2:
                            ECHO("\n--- UNLOADING AREA ---\n")!!
                            LOOK (current_passengers == 0) [
                                ECHO("The jeepney is empty! No passengers to unload.\n")!!
                            ] DROP [
                                ECHO("Enter number of passengers to unload: ")!!
                                ASK("%C", @unload_count)!!

                                ~ Constraint: Number of passengers to unload <= total number of current passengers
                                LOOK (unload_count > current_passengers) [
                                    ECHO("Cannot unload. Exceeds current passengers (%C)!\n", current_passengers)!!
                                ] DROP [
                                    unloaded = 0!!
                                    
                                    ~ Unload current passengers (seats{i4} == 1) 
                                    HOIST (i4 = 0!! i4 < 22!! +#i4) [
                                        LOOK (unloaded < unload_count && seats{i4} == 1) [
                                            seats{i4} = 0!!
                                            +#unloaded!!
                                        ]
                                    ]
                                    ECHO("Successfully unloaded %C passengers.\n", unloaded)!!
                                ]
                            ]
                            LAND!!

                        COURSE 3:
                            ECHO("\n--- PASSENGER SEAT LOCATIONS ---\n")!!
                            HOIST (i4 = 0!! i4 < 22!! +#i4) [
                                display_seat = i4 + 1!!
                                
                                LOOK (seats{i4} == 1) [
                                    ECHO("Seat %C: [OCCUPIED]\n", display_seat)!!
                                ] DROP [
                                    ECHO("Seat %C: [Vacant]\n", display_seat)!!
                                ]
                            ]
                            LAND!!

                        COURSE 4:
                            ECHO("\nArrived at terminal. End of trip!\n")!!
                            LAND!!

                        ADRIFT:
                            ECHO("\nJeep driver cannot stop anywhere! Invalid choice.\n")!!
                            LAND!!
                    ]
                ]
                LAND!!

            COURSE 5:
                ECHO("\nExiting program. Goodbye!\n")!!
                main_prog = NAY!!
                LAND!!

            ADRIFT:
                ECHO("\nInvalid choice. Please enter 1-5.\n")!!
                LAND!!
        ]
    ] HEAVE (main_prog != NAY)!!
]

Military Time to Standard Time Converter

Create a program that converts military time (24-hour format) to standard time (12-hour format) and vice versa.
column3:
AHOY() [
    COIN choice!!
    COIN hours, minutes!!
    COIN sd_time!!
    SCROLL period!!
    BOOL f_time = AYE!!

    HAUL [
        ECHO("\n=================================\n")!!
        ECHO("   MILITARY & STANDARD TIME      \n")!!
        ECHO("        CONVERTER                \n")!!
        ECHO("=================================\n")!!
        ECHO("[1] Military to Standard Time\n")!!
        ECHO("[2] Standard to Military Time\n")!!
        ECHO("[3] Exit\n")!!
        ECHO("=================================\n")!!
        ECHO("Enter choice: ")!!
        ASK("%C", @choice)!!

        CHART (choice) [

            COURSE 1:
                ECHO("\n--- Military to Standard Time ---\n")!!
                ECHO("Enter military time (0000 - 2359)\n")!!

                HAUL [
                    ECHO("Hours   (00-23): ")!!
                    ASK("%C", @hours)!!
                    LOOK (hours < 0 || hours > 23) [
                        ECHO("Invalid! Hours must be between 0 and 23.\n")!!
                    ]
                ] HEAVE (hours < 0 || hours > 23)!!

                  HAUL [
                    ECHO("Minutes (00-59): ")!!
                    ASK("%C", @minutes)!!
                    LOOK (minutes < 0 || minutes > 59) [
                        ECHO("Invalid! Minutes must be between 0 and 59.\n")!!
                    ]
                ] HEAVE (minutes < 0 || minutes > 59)!!

                ~ Determine AM or PM
                LOOK (hours == 0) [
                    sd_time = 12!!
                    period = "AM"!!
                ] DROPLOOK (hours < 12) [
                    sd_time = hours!!
                    period = "AM"!!
                ] DROPLOOK (hours == 12) [
                    sd_time = 12!!
                    period = "PM"!!
                ] DROP [
                    sd_time = hours - 12!!
                    period = "PM"!!
                ]

                ECHO("-----------------------------\n")!!
                ECHO("Military Time : %C:%C\n", hours, minutes)!!
                ECHO("Standard Time : %C:%C %S\n", sd_time, minutes, period)!!
                ECHO("-----------------------------\n")!!
                LAND!!

            COURSE 2:
                ECHO("\n--- Standard to Military Time ---\n")!!
                ECHO("Enter standard time\n")!!

                HAUL [
                    ECHO("Hours   (1-12): ")!!
                    ASK("%C", @hours)!!
                    LOOK (hours < 1 || hours > 12) [
                        ECHO("Invalid! Hours must be between 1 and 12.\n")!!
                    ]
                ] HEAVE (hours < 1 || hours > 12)!!

                HAUL [
                    ECHO("Minutes (00-59): ")!!
                    ASK("%C", @minutes)!!
                    LOOK (minutes < 0 || minutes > 59) [
                        ECHO("Invalid! Minutes must be between 0 and 59.\n")!!
                    ]
                ] HEAVE (minutes < 0 || minutes > 59)!!

                HAUL [
                    ECHO("Period  (1=AM, 2=PM): ")!!
                    ASK("%C", @choice)!!
                    LOOK (choice != 1 && choice != 2) [
                        ECHO("Invalid! Enter 1 for AM or 2 for PM.\n")!!
                    ]
                ] HEAVE (choice != 1 && choice != 2)!!

                ~ Convert to military
                LOOK (choice == 1) [
                    LOOK (hours == 12) [
                        sd_time = 0!!
                    ] DROP [
                        sd_time = hours!!
                    ]
                    period = "AM"!!
                ] DROP [
                    LOOK (hours == 12) [
                        sd_time = 12!!
                    ] DROP [
                        sd_time = hours + 12!!
                    ]
                    period = "PM"!!
                ]

                ECHO("-----------------------------\n")!!
                ECHO("Standard Time : %C:%C %S\n", hours, minutes, period)!!
                ECHO("Military Time : %C:%C\n", sd_time, minutes)!!
                ECHO("-----------------------------\n")!!
                LAND!!

            COURSE 3:
                ECHO("\nEnd!\n")!!
                f_time = NAY!!
                LAND!!

            ADRIFT:
                ECHO("\nInvalid choice. Enter 1, 2, or 3.\n")!!
                LAND!!
        ]
    ] HEAVE (f_time != NAY)!!
]

Number Guessing Game

Create a program that challenges the user to guess a secret predefined number. The user will have a limited number of attempts, and the program will provide hints after each incorrect guess.
column3:
LOCKE COIN secret = 30!!
LOCKE COIN max_tries = 7!!

AHOY() [
    COIN guess = 1!!
    COIN tries = 0!!
    COIN remaining = 0!!
    COIN diff = 0!!
    BOOL won = NAY!!

    ECHO("=================================\n")!!
    ECHO("      NUMBER GUESSING GAME       \n")!!
    ECHO("=================================\n")!!
    ECHO("You have %C attempts to guess it.\n", max_tries)!!
    ECHO("---------------------------------\n")!!

    HEAVE (tries < max_tries && won == NAY) [
        +#tries!!
        remaining = max_tries - tries!!
        ECHO("\nAttempt %C of %C\n", tries, max_tries)!!
        ASK("Your guess: %C", @guess)!!

        LOOK (guess == secret) [
            ECHO("\n*** CORRECT! ***\n")!!
            ECHO("You guessed the secret number %C!\n", secret)!!
            ECHO("You got it in %C attempt(s)!\n", tries)!!
            won = AYE!!
        ] DROPLOOK (guess < secret) [
            diff = secret - guess!!
            ECHO("Higher! ")!!
            LOOK (diff <= 3) [
                ECHO("You are VERY CLOSE!\n")!!
            ] DROPLOOK (diff <= 10) [
                ECHO("Getting WARM...\n")!!
            ] DROP [
                ECHO("Way off!\n")!!
            ]
            LOOK (remaining > 0) [
                ECHO("%C attempt(s) remaining.\n", remaining)!!
            ]
        ] DROP [
            diff = guess - secret!!
            ECHO("Too HIGH! ")!!
            LOOK (diff <= 3) [
                ECHO("You are VERY CLOSE!\n")!! 
            ] DROPLOOK (diff <= 10) [
                ECHO("Getting WARM...\n")!!
            ] DROP [
                ECHO("Way off!\n")!!
            ]
            LOOK (remaining > 0) [
                ECHO("%C attempt(s) remaining.\n", remaining)!!
            ]
        ]
    ]

    LOOK (won == NAY) [
        ECHO("\n--- GAME OVER! ---\n")!!
        ECHO("The secret number was %C.\n", secret)!!
    ]
    ECHO("=================================\n")!!
]

column2:
Array Sorting Program

Create three arrays: Array A, Array B, and Array C.

Input 5 numbers into Array A.
Input 5 numbers into Array B.

1.) Ask the user to choose whether the numbers should be sorted in ascending or descending order.

2.) Ask the user to choose the sorting technique:
Bubble Sort
Balloon Sort

3.) Use Array C to display the combined 10 sorted numbers.
column3:
AHOY() [
    COIN a{5}!!
    COIN b{5}!!
    COIN c{10}!!
    
    COIN i = 0, j = 0, c_idx = 0, temp = 0, limit = 0, j_next = 0!!
    COIN order = 0, technique = 0, vis_num = 0!!
    BOOL valid_input = NAY!!

    ECHO("=================================\n")!!
    ECHO("      Array Sorting Program      \n")!!
    ECHO("=================================\n")!!

    ~ Prompt user to fill array a
    ECHO("\n--- Input for Array A (5 numbers) ---\n")!!
    HOIST (COIN i = 0!! i < 5!! +#i) [
        vis_num = i + 1!!
        ECHO("Enter number %C: ", vis_num)!!
        ASK("%C", @a{i})!!
    ]

    ~ Prompt user to fill array b
    ECHO("\n--- Input for Array B (5 numbers) ---\n")!!
    HOIST (COIN i = 0!! i < 5!! +#i) [
        vis_num = i + 1!!
        ECHO("Enter number %C: ", vis_num)!!
        ASK("%C", @b{i})!!
    ]

    ~ Safely merge array a and array b into array c
    c_idx = 0!!
    HOIST (COIN i = 0!! i < 5!! +#i) [
        c{c_idx} = a{i}!!
        +#c_idx!!
    ]
    HOIST (COIN i = 0!! i < 5!! +#i) [
        c{c_idx} = b{i}!!
        +#c_idx!!
    ]

    ~ 1.) Ask the user to choose the sorting order
    HAUL [
        valid_input = AYE!!
        ECHO("\n1.) Choose Sorting Order:\n")!!
        ECHO("1. Ascending\n")!!
        ECHO("2. Descending\n")!!
        ECHO("Choice: ")!!
        ASK("%C", @order)!!

        LOOK (order != 1 && order != 2) [
            ECHO("Error: Please enter exactly 1 or 2.\n")!!
            valid_input = NAY!!
        ]
    ] HEAVE (valid_input == NAY)!!

    ~ 2.) Ask the user to choose the sorting technique
    HAUL [
        valid_input = AYE!!
        ECHO("\n2.) Choose Sorting Technique:\n")!!
        ECHO("1. Bubble Sort\n")!!
        ECHO("2. Balloon Sort\n")!!
        ECHO("Choice: ")!!
        ASK("%C", @technique)!!

        LOOK (technique != 1 && technique != 2) [
            ECHO("Error: Please enter exactly 1 or 2.\n")!!
            valid_input = NAY!!
        ]
    ] HEAVE (valid_input == NAY)!!

    ~ Process the chosen sorting logic
    CHART (technique) [
        COURSE 1:
            ~ BUBBLE SORT ALGORITHM
            HOIST (COIN i = 0!! i < 9!! +#i) [
                limit = 9 - i!!
                j = 0!!
                
                ~ Inner HEAVE loop safely compares adjacent elements
                HEAVE (j < limit) [
                    j_next = j + 1!!
                    
                    LOOK (order == 1) [
                        ~ Ascending Bubble Swap
                        LOOK (c{j} > c{j_next}) [
                            temp = c{j}!!
                            c{j} = c{j_next}!!
                            c{j_next} = temp!!
                        ]
                    ] DROPLOOK (order == 2) [
                        ~ Descending Bubble Swap
                        LOOK (c{j} < c{j_next}) [
                            temp = c{j}!!
                            c{j} = c{j_next}!!
                            c{j_next} = temp!!
                        ]
                    ]
                    +#j!!
                ]
            ]
            LAND!!

        COURSE 2:
            ~ BALLOON SORT ALGORITHM (Selection Variant)
            HOIST (COIN i = 0!! i < 9!! +#i) [
                j = i + 1!!
                
                ~ Inner HEAVE loop safely compares the anchored 'i' with all subsequent elements
                HEAVE (j < 10) [
                    
                    LOOK (order == 1) [
                        ~ Ascending Balloon Swap
                        LOOK (c{i} > c{j}) [
                            temp = c{i}!!
                            c{i} = c{j}!!
                            c{j} = temp!!
                        ]
                    ] DROPLOOK (order == 2) [
                        ~ Descending Balloon Swap
                        LOOK (c{i} < c{j}) [
                            temp = c{i}!!
                            c{i} = c{j}!!
                            c{j} = temp!!
                        ]
                    ]
                    +#j!!
                ]
            ]
            LAND!!

        ADRIFT:
            ~ Safety net fallback
            LAND!!
    ]

    ~ 3.) Display the combined and fully sorted 10 numbers
    ECHO("\n3.) Combined Sorted Numbers (Array C):\n")!!
    HOIST (COIN i = 0!! i < 10!! +#i) [
        ECHO("%C ", c{i})!!
    ]
    ECHO("\n")!!
]

1.) Ask the user to choose whether to input characters or numbers.

2.)If the user selects characters, allow them to input a series of characters.

3.) If the user enters a number, the program should stop accepting input.

4.) If the user selects numbers, allow them to input a series of numbers.

5.) If the user enters a character, the program should stop accepting input.
column3:
AHOY() [
    COIN choice = 0!!
    PARCH input_char = 'a'!!
    BOOL is_running = AYE, is_digit = NAY!!

    ECHO("==============================\n")!!
    ECHO("  Character & Number Checker  \n")!!

    ECHO("2. Input Numbers\n")!!

        COURSE 1:

            is_running = AYE!!

            HEAVE (is_running == AYE) [
                ECHO("Enter a character: ")!!

                LOOK (is_digit == AYE) [

            is_running = AYE!!

            HEAVE (is_running == AYE) [
                ECHO("Enter a number (0-9): ")!!
                ASK("%P", @input_char)!!

                is_digit = (input_char == '0' || input_char == '1' || input_char == '2' || input_char == '3' || input_char == '4' || input_char == '5' || input_char == '6' || input_char == '7' || input_char == '8' || input_char == '9')!!

                LOOK (is_digit == NAY) [
                    ECHO("\nCharacter detected! Stopping input.\n")!!
                    is_running = NAY!!
                ] DROP [
                    ECHO("Valid Number Entered: %P\n", input_char)!!
                ]
            ]
            LAND!!

        ADRIFT:

            LAND!!
    ]
]
